summary: Theriva Biologics filed an 8-K reporting the dosing of the first patient in its VIRAGE2 proof-of-concept clinical trial evaluating more frequent repeated dosing of VCN-01 with standard-of-care chemotherapy in first-line metastatic pancreatic cancer. This is a routine clinical milestone disclosure and does not constitute a special situation. No deal terms, strategic review, or corporate event is involved. The filing contains only Regulation FD and Other Events items with a related press release.
